name: Terminal Manager
description: Local terminal session registry and TUI detector. Tools are available to all scripts via AskMac MCP — not exposed to iPhone.

tools.name: register_session
tools.description: Register a terminal session for monitoring. Called by app scripts when a session starts.

tools.name: unregister_session
tools.description: Remove a session from the registry.

tools.name: detect_tui
tools.description: Run hook patterns against recent session output. Returns first match or null.

tools.name: read_output
tools.description: Return recent output lines from a session.

tools.name: send_key
tools.description: Send a named key to a session.

tools.name: send_text
tools.description: Clear the current input line, type text, press Enter.

tools.name: send_raw
tools.description: Write a raw string to the session without modification.
